mapper.select: select * from t_portfolio where user_num = #{userNum} and stock_code = #{stockCode}
mapper.insert: insert into t_portfolio(user_num, stock_code, user_stock_cnt, user_buy_cost) values ( #{userNum}, #{stockCode}, #{userStockCnt}, #{userBuyCost} )
mapper.delete: delete from t_portfolio where user_num = #{userNum} and stock_code = #{stockCode}
mapper.insert: insert into t_history(user_num, stock_code, trade_price, trade_cnt) values ( #{userNum}, #{stockCode}, #{tradePrice}, #{tradeCnt} )
